title: Harvard neuroscientist's telepathic kids experiments

tellings.quote: I actually just interviewed this Harvard neuroscientist who's studying these telepathic kids.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host who interviews people about UFOs and strange experiences, says he recently interviewed a Harvard neuroscientist, someone who studies the brain, who is studying children said to be telepathic, meaning they can read minds. He brings it up because if true it would mean the mind can do things science does not yet explain.
